summary: C2L1-alpha executed. K_ref=Cr_dense/Cr_dilute, K_variant=Cv_dense/Cv_dilute, alpha=K_variant/K_ref. Tie-line 0 variant K is undefined because both variant concentrations are zero. Tie-line 1 alpha=37.863, rectangular marginal-bound interval [4.769,300.647]; tie-line 2 alpha=0.335, interval [0.0422,2.661], which includes alpha=1. The intervals do not overlap, so endpoints differ under supplied bounds if assays are comparable. Tie-line index is not a controlled composition order; bounds are not confidence intervals; bulk endpoints do not map to image f. Keep G1 active.

candidates.author: executor
candidates.target: Mechanism linking RNA composition and phase partitioning to internal RNA-poor cavity appearance and persistence; f(t) is the arithmetic mean of object-level empty-area ratios.
known_relations: B f rises from 0.01381 at 0 h to 0.08918 at 24 h; A is about 0.0044 at 8-24 h (initial_measurements.json). Fields and objects are not independent preparation replicates.
B contains non-reference DNA reads, but DNA fractions do not establish RNA abundance or time course (C01).
Single-preparation length fractions show endpoint f values M near zero, M+L 0.04446, M+S 0.09412 (E02); carryover and treatment are unmatched.
C04: tie-line 1 alpha=37.863 [4.769,300.647], tie-line 2 alpha=0.335 [0.0422,2.661]. Rectangular marginal bounds are not confidence intervals. Tie-line 0 variant K undefined.
Available tracking is displacement only, without persistent cavity histories (C03).

hypotheses.statement: At fixed reaction chemistry, increasing measured variant/reference RNA loading changes relative phase selectivity non-monotonically, potentially shifting from variant enrichment in the dense phase toward weaker or reversed partitioning. If this creates or stabilizes variant-enriched dilute domains within a reference-rich dense network, those domains can appear as internal cavities. This bridge is unverified.

Selectivity is constant or measured endpoints do not represent the imaging reaction; cavities arise from amplification carryover or another reaction-state change independently of composition-driven domains.

gaps.description: Determine whether relative partition selectivity changes with measured mixture composition under matched conditions, and whether that predicts internal cavities.
No mapping from bulk phase concentrations or volumes to image f, and no causal separation from carryover.

variables_units.Cr_dilute: reference RNA concentration in dilute phase, ng/uL
variables_units.Cr_dense: reference RNA concentration in dense phase, ng/uL
variables_units.Cv_dilute: variant RNA concentration in dilute phase, ng/uL
variables_units.Cv_dense: variant RNA concentration in dense phase, ng/uL
variables_units.x_v_over_r: measured variant/reference RNA loading ratio, dimensionless
variables_units.f: image-derived object-level empty-area ratio mean, dimensionless

equations: At dense-phase volume fraction phi, variant dense-phase mass fraction=phi*Cv_dense/[phi*Cv_dense+(1-phi)*Cv_dilute]. This is not f and requires phase volumes.
H1 predicts alpha declines with measured x_v_over_r and may cross one; a cavity response is a separate unverified link.
parameters_ranges: Supplied errors propagated as rectangular marginal bounds, not confidence intervals or joint coverage.
Tie-line 0 variant K undefined because dilute concentration is zero.
No numeric cavity threshold or phase volume assigned.
candidates.initial_boundary_conditions: Phase endpoint conditions unspecified; imaging starts with similar small f; phase volumes and local cavity concentrations unavailable.
candidates.observation_mapping: f is image-derived arithmetic mean of object-level empty-area ratios, not concentration, volume fraction, mass fraction, or free energy. Phase endpoints support only bulk partition ratios under their assay conditions.
alternatives: Constant selectivity or non-transferable endpoints; cavities from carryover or other reaction-state change.
Population shifts or segmentation may alter f without same-droplet cavity formation.
predictions: H1: in a fixed-chemistry, assay-matched mixture series, alpha declines with measured x_v_over_r and may cross one; cavity incidence/area should covary after measuring phase volumes and applying fixed imaging rules.
H0: matching carryover/reaction chemistry explains cavity changes without requiring alpha to vary with RNA loading.
Current endpoints differ in alpha bounds but do not establish composition order or the cavity bridge.
checks: K and alpha dimensionless; concentrations ng/uL.
Never divide by zero or label tie-line 0 K as zero or infinity.
Do not infer composition ordering from tie-line index.
Do not equate alpha or concentration with f.
Preparation, not field/object, is replication level.
evidence_conflicts: Tie-line 1 and 2 alpha intervals do not overlap, while tie-line 2 overlaps alpha=1; assay comparability and composition order are unknown.
E02 length-fraction f differences are single-preparation, unbalanced, and lack carryover matching.
untested: Whether DNA variants produce corresponding RNA and their abundance over time.
Whether C04 tie-lines represent B RNA or the imaging reaction.
Whether dilute domains map to internal cavities and persist within droplets.
Whether carryover/reaction state explains the phenotype.
candidates.dissent: Endpoint partition differences conditionally supported; composition trend and causal cavity mechanism remain unresolved.
candidates.next_task: Keep G1 active. Obtain an assay-matched RNA mixture series with measured loading and phase concentrations; measure phase volumes and per-droplet cavity state/area under fixed chemistry, with a carryover-matched alternative.

tasks.deliverable: Interpret the executed partition calculation and specify the assay-matched composition-selectivity-to-cavity test.
tasks.acceptance: Report actual alpha and bounds; tie-line 0 undefined; do not call bounds confidence intervals or infer composition order; keep cavity bridge unverified.
tasks.reason: Endpoints indicate different relative partitioning under supplied bounds but do not identify composition dependence or explain image cavities.
